method.gate: Every candidate cohort nearest-rank full-path p95 <=210 ms, >=30% headroom under 300 ms; failures stop and are retained.
method.composition: Public predictQbModel: request validation -> resolver -> composite Q1 -> descriptor GET/parse/compatibility -> pure forecast -> Q2 -> response/serialization -> final delivery/deadline check.
method.reference: Unchanged #163 createEmpiricalAdapter; measured first before #231 SQL installation; target-independent requests selected from feature metadata.
method.cold: Fresh restricted PostgreSQL connection in a running Node process; setup included in total and reported separately. Close outside timing.
method.warm: Existing dedicated idle READ COMMITTED connection; setup zero. Cold/warm are connection states, not cache states.
method.observation: SQL/ObjectStore/hash observers on both arms; authentication hashes are setup, not artifact rehashing. Server counters/rights instrumentation removed before timing. Candidate computeMs/serializationMs are zero (not separately instrumented); both remain inside totalMs. Observer validation overhead is included. Cold deadline starts before connect.

qualification: LOCAL-FIXTURE ONLY. OS/DB/file caches unflushed; no hosted RTT/wake/region (#220), cold-cache or fresh-process claim.
limitations: Strict historical eligibility remains zero; all real requests are retrospective and retain real producer knowledge clocks.

Reference authorizes the feature only and performs its unchanged per-row qualification; candidate authorizes model plus feature and trusts producer-qualified materialization. Ratios are informational.
Synthetic PIT/correction/race/independent-lineage controls live in the behavior receipts; no synthetic histories qualify this real-fixture speed result.
Internal math and serialization are deliberately not instrumented; only the public handler and its full serialized output qualify the candidate.
database: PostgreSQL 18.6 on aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit

requests.selection: Feature metadata only; one real request at every n=2..16; no label/membership gate.

fullRecord.retention: Uncompressed record retained in the committed full-records.tar.gz bundle. A rerun creates a new sample hash.
